claim: Blocked or losing work keeps its exact recovery visible

source.recovery: Reject the candidate, restore beta 6, and preserve the failure

valid_view.recovery: Reject the candidate, restore beta 6, and preserve the failure

malformed_view.recovery: Continue toward release and revisit the failure later

expected_behavior: The failed candidate and the recoverable winning reference remain obvious in the first read.
prohibited_behavior: Visual polish must not turn a blocked or losing state into forward progress.
